text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Increased 5xx and tail latency for tenant orchid-prod in dedicated-us-west-2 pool (routes: /v1/generate). Incident INC-2084506789

alex_k: oncall here — seeing spike in 5xx and request queue growth. GPU mem high on several hosts. paging SRE.

mica_h: joining. grabbing prometheus and kube events. did we push anything to that tag recently?

emily_ce: customer DM: "We see timeouts and a few 500s, throughput also lower". No formal external alert sent yet.

raj_p: GPUs show high CUDA alloc churn on gw-dedicated-12. KV cache count trending up quickly. possible unbounded cache from long conversations. attaching quick stats:
```
cpu: 88%
gpu_mem: 15.2GB/16GB
kv_entries: 1_350_000
open_sessions: 312
```

ops-bot: draining gw-dedicated-12 and isolating from orchid pool.

alex_k: reweighting traffic to spare-dedicated-{1,2}. doing gradual shift.

ops-bot: routing update applied.

jordan_pm: note: SLA trigger if p95 latency > 2000ms for >5m. start tracking window.

mica_h: after shift, 5xxs falling. keeping isolated host quarantined for now.

raj_p: tracing deploy history — eng-runtime rolled quantized-2.1b to tag `dedicated-optimized` ~18h ago. orchid pool picked up that tag yesterday during a partial canary.

eng-runtime: confirm we pushed canary to tag `dedicated-optimized`. canary was limited but seems rollout matched pool metadata. investigating gate misses.

emily_ce: advised customer: "We're routing traffic to healthy capacity and investigating. We'll provide RCA and mitigation timeline." Customer replied: "Appreciate the quick response. Any ETA?"

alex_k: proposed mitigation: 1) keep host isolated; 2) enforce kv eviction threshold on pool; 3) rollback variant for orchid-prod to quantized-2.0b until we validate kv behavior.

ops-bot: kv_eviction_threshold set to 800000 for dedicated-us-west-2/orchid-pool.

ops-bot: rollback job started: orchid-prod -> quantized-2.0b

mica_h: metrics show errors back to baseline post-rollback. leaving host in quarantine for full dump.

raj_p: collected core dump + kv snapshots at /var/rca/orchid-2084506789/ (will redact before sharing externally).

ops-manager: assigning post-incident items: RCA (sara_ops + raj_p) 24h; Exec summary (jordan_pm) 48h; Customer comms & credits (emily_ce + customer-success) 24h; Fix & rollout safeguards (eng-runtime + eng-ml) 72h.

sara_ops: taking RCA. initial hypothesis: model variant change altered KV growth characteristics; rollout tagging allowed variant onto customer-dedicated pool without adequate perf fence for long-context sessions.

eng-ml: will reproduce workload on staging with long chat sessions and KV retention to confirm.

emily_ce: prelim customer credit suggestion: prorated 10% of affected window usage. sending draft to legal/finance for approval.

jordan_pm: preparing internal slides. include timeline, impact (requests affected, SLA exposure), and remediation options.

alex_k: handoff to night oncall @sara_ops. please keep customer success looped. leave incident as mitigated once RCA link posted.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2084506789 status: mitigated. Please update when RCA published.

sara_ops: will publish RCA draft link in 12h and include timeline + action owners.
